analysis.summary: Both Dexie packages are pinned one minor line behind: lockfile holds dexie 4.2.1 (target 4.4.5) and dexie-react-hooks 4.2.0 (target 4.4.0). Both are minor bumps within the 4.x line — no API breakage expected, closes F-DEP-009/F-DEP-010.
analysis.details: Current implementation: package.json carries ^4.2.1 / ^4.2.0 ranges; the lockfile pins 4.2.1 / 4.2.0, so `npm outdated` reports wanted>installed on the minor line. The caret ranges may already admit the targets — a lockfile refresh (`npm update dexie dexie-react-hooks` or targeted install) may suffice without touching package.json. Change surface: dependency manifests only; src/dashboard/utils/db.js schema is untouched by 4.x minors. Verify with `npm ls dexie dexie-react-hooks` and the test suite. Note for the orchestrator: issues #15-#17 (other analysis set) also modify package.json/package-lock.json; run this after those merge to avoid lockfile churn, though no content conflict is expected. Closes F-DEP-009, F-DEP-010.
